_comment: Pure-Python wheels the engine loads on demand that are not part of the Pyodide distribution: the .xlsx reader (openpyxl) and its one dependency, and the .xls reader (xlrd). scripts/sync-pyodide.mjs downloads them from PyPI at build time, checks each SHA-256 below, and serves them from this site next to Pyodide; the worker installs the wheels of one reader ("for") the first time a file of that format is read, in this order. .ods files need none (engine/opendose/workbooks.py reads them with the standard library).
